intent: A typographic scramble that decodes text left to right on view, hover or focus. Widths are reserved so lines never reflow; each character lands with a brief flash.

stack.animation: requestAnimationFrame writing to the DOM directly, WAAPI for the landing flash; motion/react for useReducedMotion only

layout.structure: one inline span per character: the real character in flow (reserves width) + an absolute overlay (inset 0, flex-centred both axes so its baseline matches the real character at any line-height) for scramble glyphs and the flash
layout.wrapping: inline spans, never inline-block, so words wrap at spaces; \n becomes
layout.demo: black stage, max-width 960px, left aligned: eyebrow, display heading, status line with live dot, hairline rule, 4-link nav + Replay pill; nav is 2x2 below @md, row above

typography.heading: display face, clamp(2.75rem, 1.1rem + 6.2vw, 6.5rem), weight 500, leading 0.95, tracking -0.045em
typography.nav: mono 12px uppercase, tracking 0.14em, white/55 to white; index numbers white/25 to #7dd3a8

color.flash: #ffffff with text-shadow 0 0 12px at 30% via color-mix (flashColor prop)
color.accent: #7dd3a8 on the live dot only (semantic: live); nav index goes white/25 → white/60 on hover

motion.stagger: min(1000 / speed, 1100 / characters) ms, speed default 32 chars/s
motion.scrambleLead: clamp(stagger * 7, 170, 380) ms per character before it resolves
motion.glyphRate: new glyph every 56ms per character, per-character phase offset, stable hash, never the final character
motion.flash: overlay shows final char in flashColor, opacity 1 to 0 over 560ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.view: IntersectionObserver 30%, once, optional delay; pre-reveal state is rendered on the server
motion.hover: pointerenter or :focus-visible on nearest a/button/[data-decode-trigger]; sweeps a scramble band through visible text; ignored while running
motion.textChange: unchanged characters (same index) stay put; changed old characters hold their place until the edge reaches them, then scramble into the new value
motion.ambient: demo status line takes a new reading every 4.2s, paused offscreen and in hidden tabs
motion.reducedMotion: final text immediately; no scramble on hover, replay or text change; the frame fades in 150ms; no ping
motion.demoEntrance: decodes are the type's entrance (eyebrow 0, heading 160ms, status 520ms); same 30% in-view triggers the frame: live dot pops 600ms, rule draws (scaleX 800ms) 620ms, nav items rise 10px out of 6px blur from 700ms 50ms apart, Replay pill 920ms; 550ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)

responsive.all: pure inline text, so it works at any width; status line wraps under its dot
responsive.demo: nav is a 2-column grid below @md (28rem), a row above; Replay pill moves beside the nav at @xl

accessibility: full text in an sr-only span, read once; the per-character layer is aria-hidden
hover trigger also fires on keyboard :focus-visible
links and the Replay button have 44px targets and a 2px white focus ring offset against black
overlay glyphs are user-select none so copying gives the real text

avoid: random Unicode, emoji or katakana rain
colour cycling, blur or persistent glow
colour on hover states or decoration; the mint dot is the only colour and it means live
